snippet.title: Mistfall Hunter - Official Cinematic Teaser
snippet.description:
Launching July 29 6PM (PT) on Steam, PlayStation Store, and Xbox. 

Wishlist Mistfall Hunter now!

Every hunt is a risk. Every extraction is earned. 
Face monsters, bosses, and rivals with your team and fight your way toward extraction. Even with the loot in hand, nothing is decided until the bell rings.
Shatter the dark, ring the fate.
 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282300/Mistfall_Hunter/
Playstation Store: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017212/
Xbox:https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mistfall-hunter/9p8x6tvw9zw8
Official Website: https://mistfallhunter.com
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mistfallhunter
